reviews.comment: Dr. Liqun is one of the sweetest professor I've ever had. This class is hard but so worth it and would definitely take this professor again. There is extra credit and he is a fair grader, tests are challenging and there are open questions, final cumulative so it will be a hard class but he does a great job teaching it.

Dr. Liu is super approachable and makes the class environment comfortable. There's random attendance extra credit and his lectures are not all out of the book, so don't skip class. The material is not bad but the exams can be challenging. He holds reviews and makes review questions as well. I really liked his class and he cares about the students.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Two midterms (30% each), one comprehensive final (40%) and 5 random bonus quizzes worth 2 points each (added to final average). Lectures are easy to follow, and numerous resources are provided to boost understanding. To be fair this class is difficult. Try to meet him outside of class, he's really cool! Honestly probably my favorite prof at A&M!
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: two tests and a comprehensive final, gives 10 points added to your overall final grade if you are present for 5 random quizzes. lectures are slow and really easy to follow.
